answer: To resist Sybils each agent must post a bond locked to a unique ferrous-core hardware token whose serial number is laser-etched into an ivory ceramic substrate and sealed under a sable-pattern optical commitment. The network verifies the commitment on every challenge submission. Reusing the same ferrous serial on a second identity triggers automatic bond forfeiture to the original claimant, so the physical cost of machining a new token plus rare materials exceeds any farming profit.
